introduction.overview:
“BEEP BOOP! Kind words make everyone happy—even your robot friend!” 🤖💖⚡

“Every day gives us little chances to be kind. We can use polite words, take turns, help others, and make thoughtful choices when we use technology!” 🌸🤝

Hello, my wonderful Class 3 friend! It is ME — BOLT, your loyal, sparkly blue robot mentor with gleaming sapphire eyes and a big glowing heart-shaped battery on my chest! 🤖💖⚡
Today, I have arrived with something truly magical: a shimmering golden treasure box filled with colorful, jingling KINDNESS MEDALS! 🎖️🎁✨ Give my metal hand a gentle, cheerful high-five right on your screen — *CLINK! BEEP BOOP!* 🖐️⚡

Imagine this sunny afternoon story:
You are sitting comfortably in the living room, building an amazing digital castle on the family tablet. Your fingers are gliding across the screen, placing colorful flags on the towers. Suddenly, your younger sister skips into the room with sparkling eyes and says: *'I want to play my animal puzzle game right now!'* 👧📱
Both of you love the tablet! Both of you are super excited to play!
Bolt floats right between you with twinkling golden lights and gently asks:
*“How can they make sure both children get a fair turn?”* 🤔💡

Do they grab the tablet back and forth like a tug-of-war rope? NO WAY! That could break the screen, hurt feelings, and cause tears! 🛑❌
Instead, you use your superpower: KINDNESS & FAIR SHARING! 💖🤝
You take a deep breath, smile, and say: *'Mommy, Papa! We both want to play on the tablet. Can you help us set a timer so we both get a fair turn?'* 👨‍👩‍👧⏰
Your parents smile, set a cheerful 15-minute kitchen timer, and say: *'You can finish your castle castle first, and then it is your sister's turn for 15 minutes!'*
While waiting for your sister's turn later, you draw a picture of a dancing robot with crayons on paper! 🖍️🤖 Everyone stays happy, the tablet stays safe, and love fills the home!

BUT REMEMBER BOLT'S GOLDEN BOUNDARY:
Being kind does NOT mean sharing everything without limits! 🔒🛡️
True kindness NEVER asks you to share your secret passwords, your home address, or your private family photos. True kindness is about fairness, politeness, patience, and mutual respect!

In this heartwarming lesson — CHAPTER 6, LESSON 2: SHARE WITH CARE — we will explore three wonderful kingdoms:
1. 🗣️💖 SECTION 1: KIND WORDS, HAPPY HELPERS! (Discovering the magic of 'Please', 'Thank you', and polite requests to humans and AI!)
2. 🤝🎁 SECTION 2: SHARE, TAKE TURNS & HELP EACH OTHER! (Mastering turn-taking clocks, patience, caring for shared screens, and guarding secret passwords!)
3. 🌍🌈 SECTION 3: BE A KIND DIGITAL CITIZEN! (Spreading joy in games, respecting different creative ideas, pressing pause on scary videos, and asking adults for help!)

Are you ready to join Bolt, open the Kindness Medal Box, and become a Certified Digital Kindness Champion? Let's take our first polite step together! 💖✨🎖️

sections.title: Kind Words, Happy Helpers! 🗣️💖
sections.content:
BEEP BOOP! Welcome to Section 1: KIND WORDS, HAPPY HELPERS! 🗣️💖✨
Words are like little paper airplanes folded from our thoughts. When we speak kind, polite, and encouraging words, our paper airplanes carry sunshine, warmth, and smiles to everyone around us! But when someone uses sharp, demanding, or rude words, their airplanes can sting feelings and make people feel sad or angry.

In this section, we learn how polite language—such as 'Please', 'Thank you', 'Excuse me', 'May I have a turn?', 'Can you help me, please?', 'I appreciate your help', 'Sorry, I made a mistake', and 'Would you like to play together?'—builds trust and happiness everywhere we go. We will also discover the fascinating difference between talking to human friends and talking to smart voice assistants like Alexa, Siri, or smart speaker helpers! 🎤🤖

Even though smart machines do not have human hearts or feelings, using polite words when asking questions is a wonderful habit that trains our minds to be polite, thoughtful human leaders! Let's explore how kind words transform our homes, classrooms, and digital worlds! 🌟🌸

parts.title: The Magic Power of Polite Words ✨🗣️
parts.content:
Think about the last time someone spoke to you. If someone walked up and shouted: *'Give me your crayon RIGHT NOW!'*, how would your tummy feel? It would probably feel tight, startled, and unhappy! 😠💥 You might not want to share your crayon at all. But what if that same person smiled gently and said: *'Excuse me, may I please borrow your green crayon when you are finished?'* 🖍️🌸 Instantly, your heart feels respected and cheerful! You would happily say: *'Of course! Here you go!'*

Polite words are not just rules from a grammar book; they are social keys that unlock cooperation, friendship, and peace. When Class 3 students use polite words, teachers notice, parents feel proud, and friends feel safe. Here are the core magic phrases every digital champion carries:
- **'Please'** 🌸: Shows that you are making a respectful request, not bossing someone around.
- **'Thank you'** 🎁: Expresses genuine gratitude and shows that you noticed someone's kindness or help.
- **'Excuse me'** 🙋: Politely gets someone's attention without interrupting or bumping into them.
- **'May I have a turn?'** ⏳: Respects that the other person is currently playing while asking for a fair turn.
- **'Can you help me, please?'** 🤝: Opens the door for teamwork when a task feels too big or confusing.
- **'I appreciate your help'** 💖: A deeper way of telling a parent, teacher, or friend how much their time meant to you.
- **'Sorry, I made a mistake'** 🩹: A brave, honest admission that heals hurt feelings and repairs friendship.
- **'Would you like to play together?'** 🎈: The most welcoming invitation in the entire playground!

parts.title: Talking with Voice Assistants & AI Helpers 🎤🤖
parts.content:
Have you ever asked a smart speaker in your living room: *'What is the weather outside today?'* or *'Set a timer for 10 minutes!'*? 🌤️⏰ Smart speakers, voice assistants, and AI chatbots are clever computer programs that listen to your spoken sound waves, turn them into digital code, search a database, and speak an answer back using synthesized audio.

Here is an important scientific truth that Bolt wants you to understand:
A voice assistant does NOT have feelings! 🤖❌ It does not feel sad if someone is rude, and it does not feel happy or warm inside if you say thank you. It has no brain cells, no beating heart, no feelings of joy, and no sadness. It is an electronic tool, just like an electric blender or a bicycle!

SO WHY DO WE ENCOURAGE SAYING 'PLEASE' AND 'THANK YOU' TO AI HELPERS? 🤔💡
Because **YOU** have human feelings, and communication is a muscle! When you practice speaking politely to voice assistants, your brain builds strong, automatic habits of respect. If a child gets into the habit of barking loud, rude commands at an AI assistant—*'DO IT NOW! PLAY MUSIC! SHUT UP!'*—that child might accidentally start talking like that to their mother, their teacher, or their classmates! 🙅‍♂️
By choosing to say: *'Please play a lion roar'* and *'Thank you, Alexa!'*, you keep your own heart gentle, polite, and respectful. You train yourself to be a polite person in every situation!

parts.title: Asking for Help at School & Home 📚🏫
parts.content:
School is a bustling workshop of learning where every student tackles puzzles, reading comprehension, mathematics, and science projects. Sometimes, a question looks like a jumbled puzzle of mysterious numbers! 🤯🔢 What should you do when you feel stuck?

Compare these two different approaches:
- **Approach A (Unkind & Demanding):** Standing up, crossing your arms, scowling, and snapping at your table partner: *'Tell me the answer NOW! You got it right, so give it to me!'* 💥❌
How does your partner feel? They feel pressured, taken advantage of, and annoyed! Giving someone the answer without explaining doesn't help anyone learn, and demanding it rudely damages friendship.
- **Approach B (Kind & Collaborative):** Leaning in with an open smile and asking: *'Could you help me understand this question, please? I am confused about step two.'* 🤝✨
What happens now? Your partner feels respected and valued! They might say: *'Sure! Look, you first count the blue blocks, and then subtract the red blocks!'* You both learn together, and you finish with a warm: *'Thank you so much! You are a great study partner!'* 🌟

Respectful requests make teamwork smooth and enjoyable. Whenever you feel frustrated, pause, take a deep breath, and turn your frustration into a polite question.

parts.title: The Healing Magic of 'I am Sorry' 🌸🫂
parts.content:
Nobody in the whole wide world is perfect—not even smart robots! 🤖 We all make mistakes. Sometimes you might get so excited about an idea that you talk right over your friend while they are speaking. Sometimes you might accidentally bump a table and knock over a tower of wooden blocks your classmate was building. 🧱💥

When a mistake happens, some children feel embarrassed and try to run away, laugh nervously, or blame someone else: *'It was the table's fault!'* But that leaves the other person feeling hurt and sad.

A true Kindness Champion uses the healing power of a sincere apology: 🌸🩹
*'I am so sorry for interrupting you while you were telling your story. Please continue, I am listening!'*
Or:
*'I am so sorry I bumped the table! That was an accident. Let me help you rebuild the tower right now!'*

Notice the three golden steps of a sincere apology:
1. Say **I am sorry** clearly and calmly.
2. Name the mistake honestly without making silly excuses.
3. Offer a kind action to make things right or invite the person to continue.
A sincere apology does not make you weak—it shows immense bravery, maturity, and emotional intelligence!

parts.title: Chatting Politely with Bolt the Robot 🤖⚡
parts.content:
Let's look at how polite conversation works between you and Bolt! 🤖💬
When you interact with Bolt in your learning app, Bolt listens to your ideas, celebrates your curiosity, and offers playful guidance.

Imagine you want to create an art piece, but your mind is completely blank. You tap your screen and speak:
*'Bolt, please help me choose a drawing idea.'* 🎨🗣️
Bolt's antenna glows bright neon green, his sapphire eyes blink happily, and he chimes:
*“BEEP BOOP! Of course! Would you like to draw a friendly robot, a flying kitten, or a rainbow castle?”* 🤖⚡🏰

You smile and reply: *'I would love to draw a flying kitten with butterfly wings, please!'*
Bolt responds: *'BEEP BOOP! Super creative choice! Let's give it purple velvet fur and sparkly silver wings!'*

Notice how the polite words create a joyful rhythm! When communication is polite, learning feels like a celebratory game. Whether you are talking to teachers, parents, classmates, or interactive mentors, polite words turn everyday tasks into delightful adventures!

sections.title: Share, Take Turns & Help Each Other! 🤝🎁
sections.content:
BEEP BOOP! Welcome to Section 2: SHARE, TAKE TURNS & HELP EACH OTHER! 🤝🎁✨
Have you ever noticed that sharing a box of sweet strawberries makes them taste even sweeter? Or that playing a two-player racing game with a friend is twice as thrilling as playing alone? Sharing is one of humanity's greatest superpowers! It connects people, creates laughter, and turns ordinary moments into unforgettable memories.

However, sharing technology—like family tablets, gaming consoles, laptops, or smartphones—can sometimes feel tricky! When two children both want to hold the same shiny tablet at the exact same moment, frustration can bubble up like a fizzy soda can. If we don't have good sharing rules, children might argue, grab, or feel left out.

In this section, we will learn how to share devices fairly through family turn-taking routines, how to care for shared electronics with gentle hands, what fun off-screen activities we can enjoy while waiting patiently for our turn, and why TRUE KINDNESS NEVER REQUIRES GIVING AWAY PASSWORDS OR PRIVATE INFORMATION! 🔒🛑 Let's master the art of fair, safe, and joyful sharing! 🌟🤝

parts.title: The Turn-Taking Clock: How to Share Without Tears ⏳🤝
parts.content:
Imagine two siblings, Kabir and his little sister Maya. Both love the family tablet. In the past, if Maya wanted the tablet while Kabir was playing, she might try to pull it from his hands. Kabir would pull back, shouting: *'No! It's my turn!'* The tablet would wobble dangerously, their mother would have to intervene, and both children would end up crying with the tablet turned off for the rest of the day. 😢📱

How did they transform their home into a Peaceful Sharing Zone? They introduced **THE TURN-TAKING CLOCK**! ⏰✨
Here is how fair turn-taking works in any family:
1. **Consult the Family Rules:** Ask Mommy or Papa how much screen time is approved for the day.
2. **Agree on the Order:** Decide calmly who goes first. A fair method is flipping a coin, checking who went second yesterday, or letting the younger sibling have the first 15 minutes.
3. **Set a Visible Timer:** Use a cheerful kitchen timer, a smartphone alarm, or a clock that both children can see. When the timer is ticking, the child playing can relax knowing their time is protected, and the child waiting knows exactly when their turn begins!
4. **Hand Over Gracefully:** When the timer chimes *DING!*, the first player pauses their game, saves their progress, wipes any fingerprints off the screen with a soft cloth, and hands the tablet over with a smile: *'Here you go, Maya! Have fun with your puzzle!'* 🎁
5. **Celebrate Cooperation:** Both children feel respected. No arguing, no grabbing, no hurt feelings!

parts.title: What Can We Do While Waiting? (Fun Off-Screen Activities) 🎨🧩
parts.content:
Waiting for your turn does NOT mean sitting on the carpet staring like a statue at the back of your sister's head! If you just sit and stare, 15 minutes feels like three long hours! ⏳😫

A smart digital champion knows how to turn waiting time into exciting **OFF-SCREEN ADVENTURES**! 🚀🌟
While your sibling is enjoying their turn, you can:
- **Build an Epic LEGO Castle:** Grab colorful building blocks and construct a space fortress for toy astronauts! 🧱🚀
- **Draw a Comic Strip:** Grab a piece of drawing paper and create a funny comic starring Bolt the Robot and a flying cat! 🖍️🐱
- **Read an Adventure Book:** Dive into an illustrated book about deep-sea creatures, rainforest jungles, or ancient pyramids! 📚🌊
- **Practice Soccer Tricks:** Head into the garden or hallway and practice balancing a soft soccer ball on your foot! ⚽🌿
- **Help in the Kitchen:** Ask a parent if you can wash crisp carrots or stir pancake batter for snack time! 🥞🥕

When you engage your mind in creative play, the timer rings before you even know it! You might even say: *'Wait, is it my turn already? I was having so much fun finishing my drawing!'* 🎨✨

parts.title: Caring for Shared Family Tech: Gentle Hands & Safe Spaces 📱🛡️
parts.content:
When a tablet, smartphone, or laptop belongs to the whole family, caring for it is a team responsibility. Electronic devices are delicate machines with glass touchscreens, tiny microchips, and sensitive camera lenses. If a device drops on a hard tile floor, the glass can crack like a spiderweb, making it unsafe for anyone to touch! 🕸️💥

Here are the four golden rules for handling shared devices:
- **Clean, Dry Hands First:** Never touch a touchscreen with sticky jam fingers, buttery popcorn hands, or wet paint! Always wash and dry your hands before tapping. 🧼🖐️
- **Two-Handed Safe Grip:** Always hold a tablet with two firm, gentle hands. Never swing it by one corner like a plastic toy briefcase! 📱🤲
- **Safe Resting Stations:** When your turn is finished, never leave the tablet on the floor, on a chair where someone might sit on it, or near the edge of a kitchen counter next to a glass of orange juice! Always place it in its designated safe dock or soft sofa table. 🪑🛡️
- **Never Change Settings or Profiles:** If your brother has his own game profile, never delete his saved high scores or change his avatar without his permission. Respect each other's digital spaces! 🎮👤

parts.title: Kindness Has Boundaries: Never Share Passwords! 🔒🛑
parts.content:
Now pay very close attention, because this is one of the MOST IMPORTANT safety truths in this entire chapter! ⚠️🛡️
Sometimes, another child at school or online might say:
*“If you are really my best friend, you will tell me your secret password so I can play with your cool avatar!”* 🗣️🔑
Or:
*“Sharing is caring! So share your secret password with me right now!”*

How should you respond? 🛑🤔
Bolt wants you to remember this forever: **PASSWORDS ARE NOT TOYS! PASSWORDS ARE SECRET DIGITAL KEYS!** 🔑🔒
True kindness does NOT mean giving away your private security keys. Giving someone your password is like giving a stranger the house keys to your family's front door! Even if someone is your best friend today, they might accidentally tell someone else, or lose control of the account.

Here is what you say politely and firmly:
*'I really like being your friend, but my family rule is that passwords are strictly secret. I cannot share my password with anyone except Mommy and Papa.'* 👨‍👩‍👧🛡️
If that person gets angry, pushes you, or threatens not to be your friend unless you give them your password, that is NOT true friendship! Walk straight to your teacher or parent and tell them what happened. A real friend respects your privacy boundaries!

parts.title: Asking Permission Before Borrowing 🙋‍♀️📲
parts.content:
Imagine your mother leaves her smartphone on the dining table to answer the door. You see the screen light up with a message notification. Should you grab the phone, swipe it open, and start tapping through her photos or messages? 📱👀
ABSOLUTELY NOT! 🛑❌

Borrowing someone else's device—whether it belongs to a parent, older brother, teacher, or friend—ALWAYS requires clear, upfront permission!
Always ask:
*'Mommy, may I please borrow your phone for 5 minutes to take a picture of my block tower?'* 📸🙋
And when permission is granted, follow their exact instructions:
- Only open the specific app you were given permission to use (like the camera app).
- Never peek into private email messages, text conversations, or bank apps.
- Return the device immediately when asked.
Respecting other people's property and privacy is the foundation of digital honor!

sections.title: Be a Kind Digital Citizen! 🌍🌈
sections.content:
BEEP BOOP! Welcome to Section 3: BE A KIND DIGITAL CITIZEN! 🌍🌈✨
What does it mean to be a citizen? In your neighborhood or school, being a good citizen means following traffic rules, putting trash in the recycling bin, holding doors open, and being friendly to your neighbors. 

A **DIGITAL CITIZEN** is someone who uses digital tools—like computers, tablets, multiplayer games, educational websites, and AI assistants—responsibly, thoughtfully, and kindly! 🌍💻
As Bolt puts it simply:
*“When we use games, videos, websites, or AI tools, we should try to be respectful, careful, and kind.”* 💖🤖

Because we cannot see people's faces through a screen, it can sometimes be easy to forget that real human beings with real feelings are playing on the other side of an avatar! In this section, we learn how to spread kindness in gaming lobbies, how to respect different creative artistic ideas, how to interact mindfully with AI writing and drawing assistants, when to press pause on scary or uncomfortable videos, and why you should NEVER have to handle unkind messages or online bullying alone! 🛡️🫂 Let's shine our brightest digital light! 🌟

parts.title: What is a Digital Citizen? The Global Playground 🌍🎮
parts.content:
Imagine the internet as the largest playground in the entire galaxy! 🪐 In this massive digital playground, millions of children and adults from Tokyo, London, Mumbai, New York, and Sydney are building virtual worlds, exploring science simulations, learning languages, and drawing art. 

Just like your school playground has rules (no pushing on the swings, no throwing sand, take turns on the slide), the digital playground thrives when everyone acts as a **Kind Digital Citizen**:
- **Speak with Warmth:** Type words that lift people up instead of knocking them down.
- **Protect Digital Space:** Don't spam chat boxes with repeated nonsense or block other players from playing fairly.
- **Protect Everyone's Privacy:** Never post someone else's name, school, address, or picture without their permission.
- **Be an Upstander, Not a Bystander:** If you see someone being teased online, don't join in or laugh; support the person and tell a trusted adult.
When you act kindly online, you make the digital universe a safer, brighter space for every explorer!

parts.title: Uplifting Teammates & Celebrating Diverse Ideas 🎨🌟
parts.content:
Have you ever played an online multiplayer soccer game or racing challenge where a teammate made a clumsy mistake and accidentally kicked the ball into their own goal? ⚽🤦‍♂️
In that split second, you have a big choice to make:
- **Choice A (The Unkind Reaction):** Typing furiously into chat: *'YOU ARE TERRIBLE AT THIS GAME! UNINSTALL NOW! NOOB!'* 💥❌
How does your teammate feel? Their heart sinks, their eyes might tear up, and they feel miserable and embarrassed. Nobody plays better when they are being yelled at.
- **Choice B (The Kind Digital Citizen Reaction):** Typing with cheerful encouragement: *'Good try! Don't worry about it, we all make mistakes. Let's try again together!'* 🌟🤝✨
What happens now? Your teammate takes a breath, feels grateful, smiles, and plays with renewed courage! You built a bond of true sportsmanship.

The same rule applies when looking at art! If a classmate uses an AI tool to create a purple flying rhinoceros with neon yellow polka dots, don't say: *'That looks ridiculous and ugly!'* Say: *'That is such an interesting and imaginative idea! I love the polka dots!'* 🎨🦏 Everyone has unique creativity, and celebrating differences makes our world rich and wonderful!

parts.title: The Power to Press Pause: Frightening & Uncomfortable Content 🛑📺
parts.content:
While exploring video streaming apps or educational websites, you might occasionally click on a thumbnail that looks innocent, but suddenly the video shows something scary, weird, confusing, or gross that makes your stomach feel funny. 📺🕷️
Some children freeze up. They think: *'My friend recommended this video, so I HAVE to finish watching it, otherwise I am being rude!'*
Or they think: *'If I tell Mommy, she will think I did something bad and take my tablet away!'*

Bolt wants you to hear this loud and clear: **YOU NEVER HAVE TO FINISH AN UNCOMFORTABLE VIDEO! YOU HAVE THE POWER TO PRESS PAUSE!** 🛑✋
Here is your 4-Step Safety Shield Protocol:
1. **Press PAUSE Immediately:** Do not keep watching! Close the video or turn the screen face-down.
2. **Do Not Feel Pressured:** It does NOT make you rude to stop watching something scary, even if a friend dared you to watch it.
3. **Tell a Trusted Adult Immediately:** Walk straight to Mommy, Papa, or your teacher and say: *'I was watching a video and it showed something confusing and scary that made my tummy feel weird. Can you please help me?'* 👨‍👩‍👧💚
4. **You Are NEVER in Trouble:** Responsible adults will never be angry with you for reporting an upsetting video. They will hug you, praise your bravery, and help block or report the bad channel!

parts.title: Mindful AI Collaboration: Creative Tools, Not Humans 🤖💡
parts.content:
Generative AI tools—like smart story assistants or sketch generators—can help you brainstorm bedtime stories, compose funny rhyming poems, or come up with game characters. When using these tools, here is how a kind, smart digital citizen behaves:

- **Use Respectful, Clear Language:** Type clear, polite prompts like: *'Please write a story about a brave squirrel who invents a solar-powered acorn collector.'* 🐿️🌰 Clear prompts yield brilliant, organized stories!
- **Remember AI Can Make Mistakes:** An AI tool does not 'know' facts like a wise teacher; it predicts words based on patterns. If an AI gives an answer that sounds weird, wrong, or confusing, always cross-check it with a school encyclopedia, a library book, or your teacher! 📚🔍
- **Never Share Private Data in AI Prompts:** Never type: *'Write a poem about my house at 12 Maple Street where my brother Arjun goes to Lincoln Elementary.'* Keep prompts purely imaginative and private! 🔒✨
- **Remember AI Does Not Have Feelings:** You don't need to worry about hurting an AI chatbot's feelings, but you should never follow dangerous or harmful advice from an AI tool. If an AI ever says anything scary, show an adult immediately!

parts.title: Photo Privacy & Standing Up Against Unkindness 📸🛡️
parts.content:
Photographs are special digital snapshots of our lives. But did you know that sharing photos online requires great care? 📸🔒
Imagine your little sister takes a funny photo where she has chocolate ice cream smeared all across her nose and cheeks. It looks hilarious! You might want to upload it to an online game forum or send it to a group chat so everyone laughs.

STOP RIGHT THERE! 🛑✋
Would your sister feel happy if hundreds of people saw that photo? What if kids at her school teased her about it? Always ask these two questions before sharing any photo:
1. **Did I ask permission from the person in the photo?** If your sister says 'No, don't share that!', you must respect her wishes completely.
2. **Did a parent approve it?** Parents know how to keep family photos safe from strangers on the public internet.

WHAT IF YOU RECEIVE AN UNKIND MESSAGE ONLINE? 💚🛑
If another player sends you a mean message like: *'Nobody likes you, leave the game'*: 
- DO NOT reply with mean words back! Fighting fire with fire only creates a bigger blaze. 🔥❌
- Freeze your fingers. Stop typing.
- Take a screenshot or leave the message open, and show it straight to a trusted adult. 
- Your parent or teacher will help you click the **BLOCK & REPORT** button. You never, ever have to handle online unkindness alone!
